apply.titleDisabled: delete at least one to apply
apply.titleEnabled: delete from Chrome the ones deleted here

scanDialog.title: Check links
scanDialog.nothing: Nothing to check: every link is up to date.
scanDialog.headsUpBody: To know whether a link is still alive, the extension requests the page from each site on your computer. Chrome will ask for a permission to access sites; it is optional and only used for this.
scanDialog.criteria: Only a 404 or 410 answer, or a domain that doesn't answer even on retry, is marked broken. A 403, a server error or a timeout is not marked.
scanDialog.offline: Couldn't check: there seems to be no connection. Whatever didn't answer is not marked.
scanDialog.deniedBody: Without the permission to access sites nothing can be checked. You can try again with the «check links» button.

applyDialog.folders: Folders left empty are deleted too.
applyDialog.headsUpBody: Chrome can't undo this. Before deleting, a copy of these bookmarks is saved to your downloads: if you change your mind, import it in the Bookmark manager and they'll come back, though in a new folder.
applyDialog.sync: If sync is on, the deletion also reaches your other devices.
applyDialog.noBackupDenied: You didn't allow downloads, so the copy can't be saved.
applyDialog.noBackupFailed: The copy couldn't be saved, and nothing has been deleted yet.
applyDialog.noBackupBody_one: If you go on, {{count}} bookmark will be deleted from Chrome without a copy and can't be recovered.
applyDialog.noBackupBody_other: If you go on, {{count}} bookmarks will be deleted from Chrome without a copy and can't be recovered.
applyDialog.doneSkipped_one: {{count}} wasn't deleted because it changed in Chrome meanwhile.
applyDialog.doneSkipped_other: {{count}} weren't deleted because they changed in Chrome meanwhile.
applyDialog.doneReloadFailed: The bookmarks were already deleted in Chrome, but the list couldn't be reloaded, so the one you see is out of date. Reload the tab to see how they ended up.
applyDialog.failedHint: Reload the tab to see how your bookmarks ended up.

grid.empty: No bookmarks match the current filter.
grid.emptyAll: No bookmarks left — all of them are deleted.
